items.description: Disposal of storm debris from shed and tree (roof timber, glass, green waste, root ball <1 m3)
items.rationale: All elements are material arising under 5.2.1(a)/(b), with the root mass under 1 m3, so the combined position is fully indemnifiable under 7.1.10. Priced from the Case 8 levels: timber ~60 + glass ~32 + green waste ~55 + root ball ~45 = ~190.

items.description: Disposal of ground material from churned-up area (soil, topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is excluded under 5.2.1(d). Disposal as a stand-alone clearance measure, with no reinstatement or making good of the ground, is not indemnified under 5.2.2; Case 8 also gave t = 0 for these items.
